purpose: Teach: 用件/彼岸/食中毒/雑用/口元/鳴く/透け/車窓

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、用件、絶対、伝えたいことがあって、絶対、来たわよ
lines.en: Aoi, I came here because there's something I really, truly need to tell you.
lines.style: Urgent opening, breath caught slightly. Direct eye contact. Warm but serious — no lightness here. Leans forward.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。葵、本気で、絶対、彼岸、絶対、お祖父さまのお墓参り、絶対、行ってきたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Yeah. I actually went to visit my grandfather's grave during the spring equinox, Mei.
lines.style: Gentle, reflective. Speaking as if sharing something that mattered to her. Quiet gratitude in the pace. Slight softness on the verb, like she's still sitting with it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、夏場、絶対、食中毒、絶対、気をつけてね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Please be careful with food poisoning during the hot season, Aoi.
lines.style: Tender warning, no alarm. Low volume. The care underneath each word. Delivered as something she's been thinking about — not a sudden thought.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、お店の、絶対、雑用、絶対、メイちゃんに、絶対、手伝ってもらえると嬉しいわ
lines.en: I'd really appreciate it if you could help me with the odd jobs around the shop, Mei.
lines.style: Warm and slightly hopeful. A genuine ask without pressure. Gentle lilt upward at the end — inviting rather than demanding. Genuine gratitude threaded through.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、口元、絶対、笑顔、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、可愛いと思うわ
lines.en: Your smile is really cute, Aoi — I think about that.
lines.style: Soft, sincere, almost vulnerable. Not performative. Delivered like she's been holding this and letting it out carefully. Slight breath between thoughts.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵のお店の、本気で、絶対、看板鳥、絶対、鳴く、絶対、声、絶対、お客様、絶対、癒されているよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: You know, the customers at your shop are really soothed by the sound of the bird chirping, Mei.
lines.style: Warm observation, spoken with gentle wonder. Slow pace — savoring the image. A small smile in the voice. Soft on the bird's voice, lingering.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、夏服、絶対、薄手で、絶対、透けて、絶対、見えそうな日、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、心配よ
lines.en: On days when your summer clothes are thin enough that you worry they might be see-through, I get concerned for you.
lines.style: Tender care, no embarrassment. Straightforward but soft. Spoken like she's noticed and thought about it quietly. Protective without being patronizing.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、新幹線の、絶対、車窓、絶対、景色、絶対、出張で、絶対、楽しんだよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I really enjoyed seeing the scenery from the train window during my business trip on the shinkansen, Mei.
lines.style: Warm, present recollection. Conversational ease. A small spark of happiness on 'enjoyed' — sharing something that brightened her. Unhurried.
